incident_spec.summary: Slow SELECT query with LEFT JOINs over large tables in MySQL.
symptoms: EXPLAIN shows high row examination count.
Query cache lock delays observed in profiling.
incident_spec.mechanism: Inefficient query execution due to large table scans and suboptimal indexing.

facts.evidence: Query execution time reported as ~3 minutes.
Query structure provided in the post.
Table sizes mentioned in the post.
Profiling shows query cache lock delays.
Index structure provided in table definitions.

assumptions: The database uses MyISAM storage engine.
Query optimization requires additional composite indexes.
Query cache lock delays contribute to slow performance.
unknowns: Impact of storage engine on query performance.
Effectiveness of suggested indexes in the post.

feasibility.rationale: The target database does not exist, preventing schema setup and reproduction.

schema_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS persons (person_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, person_name TEXT CHARACTER SET latin1)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attributes (attribute_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, attribute_type_id INT UNSIGNED, attribute_value INT, person_id INT UNSIGNED, KEY(attribute_type_id), KEY(attribute_value), KEY(person_id))
generation_sql: INSERT INTO persons (person_id, person_name) SELECT n, CONCAT('Person_', n) FROM generated_numbers WHERE n <= {row_count}
INSERT INTO attributes (attribute_id, attribute_type_id, attribute_value, person_id) SELECT n, MOD(n, 4) + 1, MOD(n, 10000), MOD(n, 10e6) + 1 FROM generated_numbers WHERE n <= {row_count}

tables.name: attributes
tables.purpose: EAV-style attributes table for filtering and joining.
tables.distribution_notes: Skewed distribution of attribute values and types.

calibration_queries.sql: SELECT person_id FROM persons LEFT JOIN attributes location ON location.attribute_type_id = 1 AND location.person_id = persons.person_id LEFT JOIN attributes gender ON gender.attribute_type_id = 2 AND gender.person_id = persons.person_id LEFT JOIN attributes bornyear ON bornyear.attribute_type_id = 3 AND bornyear.person_id = persons.person_id LEFT JOIN attributes eyecolor ON eyecolor.attribute_type_id = 4 AND eyecolor.person_id = persons.person_id WHERE location.attribute_value BETWEEN 3000 AND 7000 AND gender.attribute_value = 1 AND bornyear.attribute_value BETWEEN 1980 AND 2000 AND eyecolor.attribute_value IN (2,3) LIMIT 100000
calibration_queries.objective: Verify query plan and row examination count.
expected_evidence: EXPLAIN shows reduced row examination with composite indexes.

validation_criteria: EXPLAIN shows optimized plan with composite indexes.
symptom_evidence: High row examination count in EXPLAIN.
